breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Neumann and Dirichlet types. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The agent correctly identified and fixed this error, generating a specification that only includes the Neumann boundary conditions, which aligns with the ground truth.
